parameters.query:
INSERT INTO bookings.memberships
  (tenant_id, customer_id, plan_name, policy_template,
   monthly_rate, status, start_date, notice_period_days, notes)
VALUES
  ($1, $2::uuid, $3, COALESCE(NULLIF($4,''),'B'),
   NULLIF($5,'')::numeric, 'active', $6::date,
   COALESCE(NULLIF($7,''),'30')::int,
   NULLIF($8,''))
RETURNING id AS membership_id, plan_name, customer_id, tenant_id, start_date::text, policy_template;

options.queryReplacement:
={{ [
  parseInt($('Webhook: Create Membership').first().json.body?.tenant_id || '0'),
  $('Webhook: Create Membership').first().json.body?.customer_id,
  $('Webhook: Create Membership').first().json.body?.plan_name,
  $('Webhook: Create Membership').first().json.body?.policy_template || 'B',
  String($('Webhook: Create Membership').first().json.body?.monthly_rate || ''),
  $('Webhook: Create Membership').first().json.body?.start_date,
  String($('Webhook: Create Membership').first().json.body?.notice_period_days || '30'),
  $('Webhook: Create Membership').first().json.body?.notes || ''
] }}

  (tenant_id, membership_id, room_id, day_of_week,
   start_time, end_time, rate_per_session, active)
VALUES
  ($1, $2::uuid, $3::uuid, $4::int,
   $5::time, $6::time,
   NULLIF($7,'')::numeric,
   TRUE)
RETURNING id AS rule_id, room_id::text, day_of_week, start_time::text, end_time::text;

parameters.query:
UPDATE bookings.recurring_rules
SET
  frequency = COALESCE(NULLIF($1,''), 'weekly'),
  end_date  = NULLIF($2,'')::date
WHERE id = $3::uuid;

INSERT INTO bookings.confirmed_bookings
  (tenant_id, customer_id, room_id,
   booking_date, date_from, date_to,
   start_time, end_time,
   total_amount, deposit_paid, balance_due,
   status, is_recurring, recurring_rule_id, membership_id, updated_at)
SELECT
  $1, $2::uuid, $3::uuid,
  d::date, d::date, d::date,
  $5::time, $6::time,
  COALESCE(NULLIF($7,'')::numeric, 0),
  0,
  COALESCE(NULLIF($7,'')::numeric, 0),
  'confirmed', TRUE, $8::uuid, $9::uuid, NOW()
FROM unnest(string_to_array($4, ',')) AS t(d)
WHERE $4 <> ''
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM bookings.confirmed_bookings cb
    WHERE cb.room_id = $3::uuid
      AND cb.booking_date = d::date
      AND cb.tenant_id = $1
      AND cb.status NOT IN ('cancelled')
      AND NOT (cb.end_time <= $5::time OR cb.start_time >= $6::time)
  )
RETURNING booking_date::text, id;

SELECT base_terms, COALESCE(extra_clauses, '') AS extra_clauses
FROM bookings.membership_policy_templates
WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND code = $2
LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO bookings.customer_interactions
  (customer_id, customer_name, customer_email, customer_phone,
   booking_id, booking_date, room_name,
   subject, interaction_type, notes, timestamp, staff_member, tenant_id)
VALUES
  ($1::uuid, $2, $3, '',
   NULL, NULL, NULL,
   'Membership created: ' || $4,
   'membership',
   'Plan: ' || $4 || ', Rate: £' || $5 || '/mo, Start: ' || $6,
   NOW(), $7, $8)
RETURNING id;
